==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (250 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 8.5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) whole [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* ½ bar (50 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 1.8 oz) [[Cookbook:Chocolate#Dark Chocolate|dark chocolate]] bar of at least 60% cocoa (but no higher than 80%)<ref>I used a bar of very dark chocolate (71% cocoa solids).</ref>
* Splash [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla extract]]
* [[w:Marshmallow|Marshmallow]]s
* Dash dried ground [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]

==Procedure==
[[File:Bain-marie.JPG|thumb|Melting chocolate in an improvised [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]].|308x308px]]

#Fill the [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] with about {{convert|2|-|3|in|cm}} of water, and place it on high heat. Set a heatproof bowl on top of the saucepan to create an improvised [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]]. Then drop bits of the chocolate bar into the bowl. The steam from the water will melt the chocolate. 
#Stir until it melts completely. Stir in a dash of cayenne pepper until you no longer see any specks of red. 
#Add a handful of marshmallows and stir until they are completely melted. Add a few more if you'd rather have a sweeter cup. 
#Once the mixture is smooth, stir in just a bit of milk until the mixture is again smooth. Repeat this process until you have used all the milk. Do this slowly over the course of about 4 minutes.
#Turn off the heat and immediately (but carefully) pour into a large mug. Top with marshmallows. 

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* You could probably add a hint of [[w:Bourbon whiskey|Kentucky bourbon]] after you've added all the milk if you want it spiked.

==See also==
*[[Cookbook:Orange Hot Chocolate|Orange Hot Chocolate]]
*[[Cookbook:Hot Chocolate|Hot Chocolate]]
*[[Cookbook:Hot Cocoa|Hot Cocoa]]
